name: com.unity.timeline
description: Use Unity Timeline to create cinematic content, game-play sequences, audio sequences, and complex particle effects.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- Fix Track label name overflows when longer than available space. (UUM-130891)
- Fixed an issue where the Timeline window would try to perform operations on an invalid cached Playable. (UUM-141748)
- Fix performance regression in Custom Clip PlayableAsset Inspector where animated parameters with parent properties (nested fields) caused Timeline Window to refresh when scrubbing or playing the Timeline. (UUM-141805)
- Fixed warnings logged for DocCodeExamples track types when the Timeline package is embedded in the Packages folder. ([UUM-142491](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/UUM-142491))
- Fixed an issue where Timeline context menus would not handle '/' characters correctly when they were present in DisplayName attributes on tracks. ([UUM-144547](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/UUM-144547))
- Fixed an issue where Timeline context menus would not handle DisplayName attributes that started with a '/' correctly. ([UUM-144548](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/UUM-144548))
- Fixed errors being thrown when entering Play Mode in the Timeline Customization Samples in projects that use the Input System package. ([UUM-148499](https://jira.unity3d.com/browse/UUM-148499))

samples.description: This sample demonstrates how to create custom timeline tracks, clips, markers and actions.
This sample demonstrates how Timeline can be used to create a small in-game moment, using built-in Timeline tracks.
